owner_direction: Exclude removable end nuts completely from tab fit. Inspect shafts edge-on at the tab plane. For another form, favor precision and accept a 25–30 percent chance that the trial does not work at all.

risk.meaning: Owner's remake-risk budget, not a probability estimated from scans. No statistical calibration or independent trials support a numerical likelihood.

nut_policy: No nut diameter, silhouette, depth or mesh enters any clearance calculation. Nuts are removed for fitting and withdrawing the tool. Hidden bare-shaft length remains unknown.

scan_frames.without_inner_plate: Existing FT02 working cover placement; primary registration unchanged. Subtract 8.05 mm from installed Z for front-face coordinates. Historical 80 mm U–L calibration retained.
scan_frames.with_formwork: FS01 independent Ø240 exact-print calibration. Front face Z=0. No caliper scaling, local warp or forced shaft registration.
scan_frames.with_inner_plate: Retained as assembly evidence; its inner plate obscures this repair form's tab plane. Not used to infer unobserved shaft/tab contact.

shaft_fit.diameter_basis: Existing project identification of Kohler 1038645 as nominal 10-24 (0.190 inch). Use a deliberately selected 5 mm cylinder for trial checks, not the scan's artificially thin reconstructed shaft. Neither is a new physical reading or an accuracy bound.
shaft_fit.forward_extent_basis: Chosen sensitivity interval from tab back at -3 through +20 mm. It is not a measured bare endpoint or proof of the complete insertion path; no nut geometry determines it.

local_tab_fit.scope: Fit each visible distal outer tab arc to its known R8 circle, independently of the shaft. Transfer the known 2 mm tab-end-to-slot-center offset. Fixed/free-radius alternatives and section sensitivity are reported; no local remapping of the source mesh.

trial.purpose: Optional tighter locator trial for a future 24 mm relieved repair form; not a replacement selection or permanent escutcheon.
trial.center_basis: Practical chosen coordinates near the midpoints of the original scan's inferred bare-shaft insertion envelopes. This preserves the existing control-centered working pose and leaves a small geometric clearance; it does not copy or force the later form's captured pose. Coordinate decimal places are CAD choices, not measurement accuracy.
trial.unchanged: Complete collar, reliefs, broad face, central aperture and tab outside boundaries. Only locating openings differ. Neither central control-access envelope nor factory plate measurements is changed.
trial.printing: Geometry-only mm STL/3MF/STEP; 100 percent scale, same orientation and PETG setup as PS01. Use existing printer profile. Print one chosen size for the experiment. No machine-specific G-code or purchase.

physical_scope: A scan observation is not full seating, repeatability, a water test or a measured print tolerance. A tight tool that binds is a failed trial; do not use the nuts to pull it into place. Existing bracing/release requirements remain. No owner measurement is requested.
